title: The symmetric normal bundle and its specified exceptional fibre map
statement: Let S be Noetherian and g:V->S smooth of pure relative dimension d with closed section s and s;g=id [def-pc-scheme], [def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring], [def-sbc-smooth-morphisms], [def-weil-closed-immersion]. Put E=I/I^2 using the actual conormal algebra [lem-pur-conormal-graded-algebra]. Its local rank d and the invertibility of the canonical Sym(E)->gr_I comparison are the well-definedness properties from centred coordinates. Define N=relative Spec Sym(E), pi and z using [def-asd-vector-bundle-zero-section]. Define the actual Rees-cone-to-N isomorphism as the homogeneous-normalized Rees comparison [def-pur-finite-smooth-canonical-interfaces], followed by relative Spec of the canonical symmetric comparison, contravariantly. Its inverse followed by the actual Rees zero-fibre inclusion is the canonical N->D_sV [def-pur-dnc-section-family]. This is the Cartesian zero fibre and carries z to the augmentation section. The affine pi is quasi-compact. For finite commutative A, if q and pi are compactifiable [def-asd-compactifiable], define eta:i0*F->z*pi^times A by applying the counit-defined section map [def-pur-noetherian-section-specialization-arrows] to that fixed square. No isomorphism is selected from a mere Nonempty existence statement.
